messages:
maya: quick idea 12 we should formalize a compact state-machine + staged rollout for continuous-batcher fallbacks. current ad-hoc flow causes oscillation.
chris: agreed. states? NORMAL -> PREALERT -> DEGRADED -> MICROBATCH -> RECOVERING -> NORMAL sounds right.
devon: detection: composite stress_index (queue_depth, eviction_rate, p99_delta) over 3 windows to avoid noise.
anika: prefer staged percent rollout (10,30,60,100) with canary metrics (p95, eviction_rate). abort if p95 > +20% or eviction_rate x2.
frank: ops: toggles must be idempotent and per-pool. hosts store last_cmd_id and local_version to prevent split-brain.
maya: add cooldown: pools can't re-enter DEGRADED/MICROBATCH within 10m unless manual. also avoid auto-demoting reserved lanes.
chris: implement LeaseDecision enum: KEEP, DEMOTE, THROTTLE, EVICT. handlers pure for simulation.
devon: i'll build a small simulation harness (short-heavy vs long-context vs reserved tenants) to validate no reserved-lane p99 regressions.
anika: i'll emit structured events: fallback_command, host_apply, rollback with tags.
frank: i'll draft the runbook and verify control-plane auth for toggles.
ops-bot: created incident template batcher-fallback-compact (id: BF-1789660000).
maya: i'll write the follow-up RFC with state graph and sample curl. assigning owners: chris (state machine), devon (sim), anika (observability), frank (runbook). thanks :thumbsup:
